title: WebSec Audit-Reality Snapshot
description: Four immutable pins: source tree, deployed bytecode/proxy reality, chain state, and toolchain/config. A finding is only trusted against a campaign when its pins match the campaign's active pins; otherwise it must be re-verified, never silently trusted.

snapshot_id.description: sha256 over the source pin — the canonical pin id all findings reference

pinned.description: false => HALT mode: discovery allowed, but no CONFIRMED verdicts may be issued

ladder.description: git-clean => commit_hash alone; git-dirty => commit_hash+content_hash; no-vcs => content hash only; artifact => file hash; live => timestamp (unpinned)

content_hash.description: sha256 over every file in the pinned copy, path-sorted, path prefixed

root.description: filesystem path of the immutable pinned copy

excluded.description: relative subpaths pruned from this pin by the bulk-default or --exclude sets, reported at their real depth (a deep match under an in-scope dir is its own subpath, not the top-level dir) — an audit pin that silently drops scope is a scope-drift bug, so the prune is recorded, not hidden

deployment.description: what is ACTUALLY deployed — never assumed to match source for unverified contracts

network.description: chain id or name, e.g. ethereum-mainnet, base-sepolia

verification_ratio.description: fraction of in-scope contracts with verified source

source_match.description: does deployed bytecode match locally compiled source?

chain.description: fork/state pin: a bug reproducible at block N may not exist at N+50000

state_refs.description: named on-chain state values this audit depends on (prices, totals, roles)

manifest.description: cryptographically self-describing summary of the snapshot: finding -> evidence -> snapshot -> exact artifact/environment becomes independently verifiable. manifest_hash is a digest over the manifest's own fields, so the manifest cannot be edited after the fact. Absent on legacy pins (pre-manifest); the audit verifies it wherever present.

source_merkle_root.description: Merkle root over every file in the pinned tree — supports path membership proofs

deployment_merkle_root.description: Merkle root over per-contract identity+bytecode hashes

chain_fingerprint.description: canonical hash of chain id + fork block + fork block hash

toolchain_fingerprint.description: canonical hash of the recorded toolchain config

dependency_lock_hash.description: Merkle root over the dependency lockfiles present in the pinned tree

environment_hash.description: python version + platform the pin was produced under

manifest_hash.description: digest over the manifest's own fields (self-anchoring)

config.description: toolchain + environment versions; required for reproducibility of any produced evidence
